title: NATO alphabet
objective: Spell your registration, an airport code and your aircraft type the way they are spoken on the radio.

phraseologyNote.title: NATO alphabet
phraseologyNote.shortExplanation: Letters are always spoken with the ICAO/NATO alphabet: Alpha, Bravo, Charlie…
phraseologyNote.example: SP-TFA: Sierra Papa Tango Foxtrot Alpha
phraseologyNote.whyItMatters: Single letters sound alike on a noisy frequency; code words do not.

steps.speaker: pilot
steps.prompt: Say your aircraft registration SP-TFA using the NATO alphabet.

steps.speaker: pilot
steps.prompt: Spell the ICAO code of Poznań airport: EPPO.

steps.speaker: pilot
steps.prompt: Say your aircraft type (Cessna 172) followed by your registration.
